C0849.title: Criminal Gang Uses 'Silver Fox' Trojan Variant in Mass Phishing Emails to Steal Corporate Data
C0849.summary: Jilin police cyber units recently identified a criminal gang led by a suspect surnamed Chen that developed a 'Silver Fox' Trojan variant. The group employed techniques to evade security detection, sent phishing emails in bulk, and conducted targeted attacks against employees of enterprises and public institutions to steal corporate data and construct fraud scenarios, involving over 7 million yuan.
